label: Diagram 6.5
caption: Diagram 6.5 Minimum space requirements for wall-mounted charge point location
description: The drawing, captioned "Diagram 6.5 Minimum space requirements for wall-mounted charge point location", has two parts. The left part, labelled "Front elevation", shows two vertical hatched "Wall/object" members on either side of a horizontal hatched floor. Between them sits a green rectangle labelled "Wall-mounted charge point", with "Free space" marked to its left and right. A horizontal dimension line above reads "≥800mm" from the left wall to the point, "≥400mm" across the point, and "≥800mm" from the point to the right wall. A vertical dimension on the left reads "700 to 1000mm", measuring the floor to the bottom edge of the point. The right part, labelled "Side elevation", shows the point projecting from a hatched wall, above a hatched floor marked "Floor". A top dimension of "≥200mm" gives its depth, and a vertical dimension of "≥500mm" gives its height.
